Landed on main at 709a5339 (fast-forwarded onto main) (single-developer mode, self-reported gate, LocallyObserved).

Evidence: checkAll on a clean git-archive export of 709a5339: 4992 tests, 4988 passed, 0 failed or errored, 4 skipped by assume, 51 suite summaries, EXIT 0. media suites 40/40 under the PATH Homebrew tools and 40/40 under STORYMODEL4S_FFPROBE/FFMPEG pointing at the realized 9.0.1 binaries (identity equality holds under the recorded binary; picture packet tables equal under both). Mutation witnesses: edit-list guard 2/2 (discard clause dropped; start clause dropped), each killed by the edit-list court; the earlier 28 stand. Third cold review (cold-review-c.md) findings fixed: guard reordered so the discard clause is reachable and witnessed on a middle-packet discard; WorkerRealization.observe gives the live courts a worker realization observed independently of the outcome; overclaims in the guard's Scaladoc and ADR 0007 corrected; ADR status line updated; ledger §6.1 scope names the edit-list assumption.

Realization: FFmpeg 9.0.1 from the signature-verified tarball (sha256 cf38e0e2…, key fingerprint FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8 = ledger §4), built by media/tools/build_ffmpeg_9.0.1.sh as LGPL-only, everything disabled except the F0/F1-required components, static; ffprobe 13d17dfd…, ffmpeg 85c119a5…. F0/F1 envelopes re-recorded under it; decoded frames byte-identical to the earlier Homebrew decodes; F0 packet table identical; F1 picture table identical, last audio packet duration 1024 vs 1008.

Not established: build reproducibility (two builds differ; no second clean build compared); no SBOM, OCI, or corresponding-source bundle; patent and jurisdiction HoldUnknown; the realized binaries are not committed (worktree tmp/); the elst is never read, so an edit list folded without a start shift or discard flag passes; `applied` is trusted from the pinned script's reading of private attributes; lumaOnly checked only via applied weights; `container` never compared; a set but unusable tool override skips the live court silently; the colour arguments are load-bearing for F1 but not required by any join.
